How do I get an account?
Choose how you will use Sentinel
Create your organisation on the Sentinel website, then add sites, supervisors and guards from the secure web portal.
I want to look around first
Open the offline demo to preview shifts, patrols and reporting without creating or sending any information.

For your security, guard accounts are created by your employer or supervisor and linked to the correct company, site and permissions. Ask them for your username and company setup QR code. Sentinel support should never ask for your password.
